name: launcher-rebuild
comment: Rebuilding a game's C# from inside the launcher, then running it. This is the Unity-shaped loop the whole design exists for: edit C#, press a button, play — no C++ build, no process restart. The click lands on Flappy's Rebuild button; a publish takes seconds, hence the generous timeout.

steps.comment: Flappy's Rebuild button. The menu is centred at a fixed 640x480 inside a 1600x900 window, so this is stable. Move and press are separate steps with frames in between: ImGui hit-tests against the position it saw last frame, so a move and a press delivered together land on nothing.
The freshly published assembly is what actually loaded.
